source.data_source: Neon sector_snapshots table row closest to target date; on-chain overrides applied for May 31, 2026 per lib/compound-onchain.ts and lib/euler-onchain.ts.
source.methodology: LDR = borrowed / (tvl + borrowed) × 100, computed per protocol via lib/sector-derived.ts ldrByProtocol(). Mechanically equivalent to utilization but framed as a depositor-efficiency metric.
override_notes: compound-v3 tvl/borrowed substituted with on-chain Comet totals (USDC+USDT+WETH+USDS bases) per lib/compound-onchain.ts.
euler-v2 tvl/borrowed substituted with on-chain EVK totals (Σ totalAssets / Σ totalBorrows across active vaults) per lib/euler-onchain.ts.
On-chain readers run at latest block; snapshot row is dated 2026-06-29. Any drift between the two is smaller than DefiLlama's over-count on Compound V3 + Euler V2.
